claim_boundary: This is a finite modular height scout for one coordinate. It neither proves nor disproves a QQ solution or polynomial identity, and it makes no colon, saturation, secant-closure, or HC4 claim.
conditional_height_conclusion: If one rational fixed-gauge coordinate reduces to every displayed source and selector residue, then for every declared scale s the reduced value s*q satisfies 2*abs(num(s*q))*den(s*q) >= M.

normalization_family.construction: For every positive divisor d of 154224 and m in {1,10,36000}, test the reduced scales d*m, d/m, m/d, and 1/(d*m).
normalization_family.name: structural-v1
